data.why: The dashboard loads data/example_dataset/Entries/*.csv automatically at startup via load_example_dataset(); this is already bundled in the repository, so nothing needs to be copied or written.

goals: Load the bundled Atlantic Forest orchid occurrence dataset and confirm it renders without errors
Filter occurrence records by species, family, state, country and year range to scope a sub-population of interest
Switch between the Plotly and Folium map engines and toggle the density heatmap to assess spatial clustering of records
Read the KPI summary (record count, species count, percent georeferenced) to judge data completeness for a filtered subset
Inspect the by-family/state/country/year bar charts to spot which categories dominate or are under-sampled
Download the currently filtered records as CSV for further analysis outside the dashboard

review.summary: The tree captures what the dashboard is for: scope occurrence records, map them, judge completeness and sampling balance, and export them. Its evidence and numbers hold up on inspection. It needs a pass to state how QC-validated coordinates drive the map and the georeferenced %, to flag the unconfirmed Folium cluster path, and to fix a few mislabeled API names and missing filter contexts before filing.
